subtitle_invalid.name: subtitle_invalid
subtitle_invalid.long_description: The specified subtitle codec is invalid or not recognized by the system.

subtitle_none.name: subtitle_none
subtitle_none.long_description: Indicates that no subtitle codec is selected or used.

subtitle_ass.name: ass
subtitle_ass.long_description: Uses the Advanced Substation Alpha (ASS) format for rich-text subtitles with styling and positioning.

subtitle_hdmv_pgs_subtitle.name: hdmv_pgs_subtitle
subtitle_hdmv_pgs_subtitle.long_description: Uses the HDMV PGS subtitle format for image-based subtitles.

subtitle_srt.name: srt
subtitle_srt.long_description: Uses the SubRip Subtitle (SRT) format for subtitle encoding and decoding.

subtitle_ssa.name: ssa
subtitle_ssa.long_description: Uses the Substation Alpha (SSA) subtitle format, supporting basic styling and positioning.

subtitle_subrip.name: subrip
subtitle_subrip.long_description: Uses the SUBRIP subtitle format for simple, text-based subtitles.

subtitle_dvb_sub.name: dvb_sub
subtitle_dvb_sub.long_description: Uses the Digital Video Broadcasting (DVB) subtitle format for television broadcasts.

subtitle_webvtt.name: webvtt
subtitle_webvtt.long_description: Uses the Web Video Text Tracks (WebVTT) format for HTML5 video subtitles.

subtitle_mov_text.name: mov_text
subtitle_mov_text.long_description: Uses the QuickTime MOV text format for subtitles in MOV files.
